title: Paris to Host Unified Football World Cup at Charléty in July 2026
summary: Paris will host the Unified Football World Cup at the Charléty stadium from July 5 to 11, 2026. This event features teams comprised of players with intellectual disabilities, promoting inclusion and accessibility in sports for people with cognitive conditions.
body:
Paris will host the Unified Football World Cup at the Charléty stadium from July 5 to 11, 2026. This event features teams comprised of players with intellectual disabilities, promoting inclusion and accessibility in sports for people with cognitive conditions.
